name: HB-2 ToT/RAP repo-port smoke
purpose: Port the llm-reasoners ToT and RAP control patterns onto the shared HB-2 budget/scoring substrate and run a minimal sudoku+graph_color smoke. ToT is represented as action proposal plus state evaluation under beam search; RAP is represented as MCTS select/expand/rollout/backprop with LLM action/value calls. This validates repo-grounded runners but is not a final HB-2 comparison.

provenance.spec: user CODING SPEC — HB-2 External No-Train Matched-Budget Comparison (consolidated, v1)

code_added_used.change: Adds ToT beam and RAP MCTS smoke adapters over the common CSP/graph_color environment with shared token billing and official scoring.

commands.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 ~/.local/bin/uv run --python .venv/bin/python python -m analysis.kvcache_tot_rap_baselines --output results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_tot_rap/item127_tot_rap_smoke_sudoku_graph_n1.json --checkpoint-path results/kvcache_matched_budget_v0/hb2_tot_rap/item127_tot_rap_smoke_sudoku_graph_n1_checkpoint.json --tasks sudoku,graph_color --methods tot,rap --n-instances 1 --scan-limit 20 --budget-anchors sudoku:28070,graph_color:32895 --max-expansions 2 --mcts-iters 2 --max-depth 3 --n-actions 2 --beam-size 2 --rollout-depth 1 --rollout-branching 1 --max-new-tokens 96 --dtype fp32 --device cuda
commands.purpose: Run B*-only ToT/RAP smoke on one sudoku and one graph_color instance.

headline.single_next_move: Decide whether to scale external smokes first or add optional First Finish before final HB-2 table assembly.

gate_outcomes.number: Runner records maitrix-org/llm-reasoners commit f94e5ac2cb9788c3d7d7dbf2173884ed4088e4b2 and maps ToT/RAP search patterns from upstream examples.
All proposal/evaluation/rollout calls bill input plus generated tokens and stop before exceeding budget_B.
Rows use the same official CSP/graph_color scoring substrate as LFS and best-of-n.
n=1 expansion-capped smoke only; futoshiki, budget grids, and final external-baseline comparison are not complete.

decision.next_step_routing: Keep HB-2 open. Scale best-of-n/LFS/ToT/RAP or add optional First Finish before claiming final no-train matched-budget conclusions.

honesty.does_not_establish: This item does not complete HB-2 and does not show ToT/RAP competitiveness. It only validates repo-grounded ToT/RAP adapters on the shared budget/scoring substrate.
honesty.scope_limit: n=1, B*-only, sudoku+graph_color only, max_expansions=2, max_depth=3, and no futoshiki. These are smoke rows, not curves.
honesty.implementation_limit: The upstream llm-reasoners algorithms are adapted to this repo's CSP/graph_color substrate rather than vendored directly. ToT preserves propose/evaluate plus beam-style search; RAP preserves MCTS selection/expansion/rollout/backprop over LLM action/value calls.
honesty.parse_note: ToT graph_color used fallback for two unparsable proposal/value responses; this is recorded as parse_fails=2 and should be improved before large runs.
honesty.external_limit: Optional First Finish is still not ported/run. Beyond-the-Frontier remains final-not-run because no official repo was found.
